venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Monday 8/24 (MOD: MKZ)** Chill Monday well over target. Sold 5 Meal Deals to start; IG bartender Chris Leavitt (@notjustabartender) stopped in with Jose from Mid City ~5:30pm — Tre hosted them at the bar with aquavit adventure gimlets and a round of shots. Steady rest of night; at one point every seat and bar stool taken, plus a last-minute group at 11. Kitchen: quick ticket times, clean close, staff meal a classic Kieran Curry. Comps $42.01 (community/investor, industry, tip-only discount). 86'd/low: High Life ponies. No incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Monday 8/24 (MOD: KE/DM)** Slower evening; first few hours completely dead, bulk of sales after 9:30 when a handful of groups came in. Lipman brand reps in for a round; fishmonger friends post-shift; downtown bartender Jasmine back for an espresso martini. Comps $28 / 3.41% (popcorn comp for an over-served guest, friends & family, industry) — small in $ but stands out on low sales. Kitchen smooth. Low: Montenegro (restock in a day or two). No-shows not charged.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Monday 8/24 (AM: Carey / PM: Maggie H & Chef Rachel)** Beat target on a rainy, cozy night. DC/AM $927.24 (calm, light pops; $5 owed-to-house discrepancy at closeout; double batches of meile, mocha, caramel; low black tea; 86 evergreen, kombucha). D&C PM $6,890.31 — 6pm popped off revenue-wise; heavy 86s including no oysters for Oyster Monday (also scallops, truffled mush, Sun Break Cab Sav); removed Add Trout Roe button in Toast and updated caviar to $8; a few guest-recovery food discounts on consistency issues two days running; ongoing side-work/expectations conversations. Kitchen: good night with Danté and Marv, deep cleaning done, many 911 preps (scallop, rabbit, succotash, mushrooms etc.). Comps $238.40. No incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Monday 8/24 (MOD: Kyler/Thomas)** Sleepy Monday under target — brief pop at 7pm filled nearly every seat, quiet after 8:30; theory: post-weekend fatigue, several tables explicitly one-and-done. Very high GCA for the covers thanks to wine-and-dining cocktail heads and longer experiences. 84 covers, 1 large party, 2 solos, 1 investor cocktail. Top sellers: Burner Phone, King Mambo, Shinebox/Stepping Razor (tie). Industry: Dominic (S&G), Gabriel (Wayland), Evan Saez, Nick Anewalt. Kitchen: one table left on arrival due to no full food menu. Comps $88.42 (oyster-recovery gifts, industry regulars). Maintenance: mice in kitchen. No no-shows.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Monday 8/24 (MOD: Mikey & Vic)** Beat target with good energy and a solid pop through the night; a few guests lingered ~an hour past close, cleared by 12:45am. Vic's last Oyster Monday — closed with a final oyster cheers. Issue: Marquee service-bar drain overflowed ~9:30pm, stopped draining entirely by EON; glassware washed in kitchen dish machine; needs fix before tomorrow's service. Comps $88 (Ravens industry friends, DNL, birthday, mis-ring). No-shows charged. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Monday 8/24 (MOD: Josh)** Over target on the strength of $2,680 in event sales; walk-in bar business extremely slow (Marquee bar $779.71) with little foot traffic — Restaurant Week impact, hoping The Dabney and neighbors reopening brings movement. Team used downtime to deep clean and reset Marquee. Oysters were the top movers. Comps $17, voids $22. Garden closed. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: guest at bar 1 hand-writing notes for her wedding guests.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: A bit of rain, mostly sunny
venues.narrative: **MG — Monday 8/24 (AM: Sam & Shannon / PM: Justin & Marcus)** Well under target on a very quiet Monday. Morning $416 (22 guests, food tour of 4). Evening $1,957 (45 guests) — quiet happy hour, no large parties, empty bar 10:30 to close; ran lean with two servers and a solo bartender closing without barback. Sun Club $591 — chill and steady, Aimee trained on menu drinks. Hot Eye closed ($0). Event: $250 from a standalone Mezz Room rental. Kitchen: low dumplings (911 prep), still out of frisée (rep promises tomorrow). Comps $106.95. No incidents.
